# harness_platform_iacm_workspace_drift_config (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving IaCM workspace-level drift detection configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier where the project resides.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier where the workspace resides.
- `provisioner_type` (String) Provisioner type to retrieve drift configuration for (terraform, opentofu, terragrunt, awscdk).
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace identifier to retrieve drift configuration for.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether workspace-level drift automation is currently enabled.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pipeline_id` (String) Pipeline configured for drift detection.
- `run_every` (Number) Repeat interval — run drift detection every N units.
- `run_every_unit` (String) Unit for the run_every interval. Valid values: seconds (1–59), minutes (1–59), hours (1–24), days (1–31).
- `trigger_id` (String) Generated trigger identifier assigned by the backend when drift is enabled.
